dedupe_keys.name: attest t3 1 optimization tool for distribution network planning

description: José Nicolás Melchor Gutierrez, Andrey Churkin, Kong Wangwei and Eduardo Alejandro Martínez Ceseña publish the ATTEST T3.1 distribution-network planning tool. It combines multi-stage stochastic optimisation with a path-dependent, non-recombining scenario tree and a recursive simulation-based search. The resulting reinforcement strategies can adapt to different future paths and exploit flexible resources. The October 2023 Zenodo release provides a software ZIP at no cost under EUPL 1.2. The Python tool reads a MATPOWER network and an EV/PV/storage workbook, accepts cost and demand-growth assumptions, and writes investment costs to JSON. The example compares active- and slow-economy scenarios through 2050; geographical coverage and planning horizon are configurable. The tool supports distribution investment and flexibility simulations; its optimisation results were not reproduced. Related catalogue records cover the separate ATTEST transmission-planning tool and project test networks. Those records do not explicitly package this distribution-planning implementation. The archive was not opened.
